title: Nashville's Primrose Cottage in Hip Belmont Area
description:
Our cozy stone cottage is a wonderful home in a beautiful neighborhood filled with mature trees. Just minutes away from Belmont and Vanderbilt, 2 miles to downtown and walkable to some of the best places in eat in Nashville's 12 South district. Our home offers 2 bedrooms, 2 full baths and a loft with twin beds for extra guests that come to visit. A beautiful back deck provides space to enjoy your morning coffee or to unwind with an evening cocktail.

The space
Our cottage has a stocked, remodeled kitchen with new appliances including a Keurig coffeemaker multi pot. We provide local coffee beans to add that Nashville flavor! 
Cook dinner at home or walk to great eateries in the Belmont or 12 South neighborhoods. 
Each queen bed has a new Lucid mattress. All beds have cozy bedding, including the twin beds in the loft. 
The loft has a dedicated office space should you need to work while here. You will need to climb stair to access the loft area. 
Laundry area is in the basement and features a new washer and dryer.
